methodology: Use the latest clean committed predecessor that accepts the same command surface and implements the same always-on analysis capabilities, optional evidence, and report generation as the candidate.
Treat the frozen-input provenance commit as corpus provenance only; retain comparisons against capability-incomplete commits as diagnostics, not budget passes, failures, or approved exceptions.
Resolve dependencies before the first measured run.
Run the release build command once after dependency resolution.
Run the selected platform measure command for one warmup run and discard that sample.
Run the same command for fifteen measured runs without changing inputs.
Use benchmarks/debtmap-baseline/fixtures/example.lcov and the frozen 2026-09-22T00:00:00Z debt reference time for full-evidence measurements.
For full-evidence measurements, copy Example.swift to the root of a temporary Git repository and commit it with fixed author and committer metadata at 2026-09-12T12:00:00Z.
Record elapsed wall-clock seconds and peak resident memory from the platform time tool.

Record phase-wall-clock nanoseconds from the analyzer profile output for discovery, parsing, structural evidence, graph, coverage, repository history, functional evidence, scoring, aggregation and rendering when those phases run.
Report every raw sample, median, minimum and maximum with the Swift version, OS, CPU model and memory size.
Use medians for CI regression gates and include all raw samples when requesting an approved exception.
Run .github/workflows/debtmap-performance.yml on pull requests to enforce both regression budgets against equivalent frozen SwiftDebt workloads.

referenceRequirements: same always-on structural and functional debt evidence
approvedExceptionEvidence: all raw wall-clock and peak-memory samples
profile output for the candidate run
written justification for accepting the regression

platformVariance.ciUsage: Compare medians from the same OS family and architecture where possible; otherwise require approved exception evidence.
